The '''Luj system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system shared its name with [[Luj City]], a [[City/Legends|settlement]] on the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Novor 23]].<ref name="Sisar">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Luj system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square N-19.<ref name="TEA" />
